answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The comet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jade. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
